Layer the SIC-specific cubic (p6) to achieve the full degree-288 tower
Reconstitute K_d from the complete p1-p6 relative polynomial stack
Verify sum of squared moduli equals unity for the recovered vector
Commit the degree-288 reduction theorem to constant memory
